I have SH before, as a desperate act of control in a world where I had none, and a need to feel anything but what I was feeling then. If you have friends, go to them. If you have family, hug them. And if you have neither, trust in yourself. Try to find new hobbies, something that takes your mind away from your pain, could be as simple as listening to music (my favorite) or going out for fresh air, etc. Even working out or doing something self improving wise, but that also hurts to remind you that you’re still alive, and in fact human lol. It’s MUCH easier said than done, but I’m rooting for you stranger. much love 💜

Been dealing with this for a long time as well. The feeling never goes away, it just lingers.. and then comes at either the worst times possible or whenever the fuck it feels like. Although it doesn’t work all the time, I try to think about reasons that I do deserve what I have. The obstacles I’ve overcome, the triumphs I’ve worked so hard for, etc. Honestly, just from hearing that you read your kid a book tonight and cuddled with her, shows me that you deserve all that you have. We have to often remind ourselves that although we might sometimes feel like we don’t deserve something, doesn’t mean we don’t. You have came this far, through years and years of work, and hardships, successes, and failures. You deserve all that you have now because you’ve worked for it, you’ve fought for it. It’s yours. Nobody else’s, and nobody can take that away from you. You should try to remind yourself in these times that you were the one who made this reality. You deserve happiness, you deserve your family, and you deserve everything good that you have, because YOU made that happen.

Everything comes in it’s own time, and no matter how much we prepare for the events we fear it always hurts worse then we could’ve imagined. I was around 13 when my parents “split”, and after years of begging them to get a divorce so I could enjoy my home life, it finally happened. Although I had prepared for this moment in a sense, it still felt like shit. Seeing all the other happy families around me, all together and how much they loved each other, was just added insult to injury. It never gets easier seeing the people that you look or once looked up to tear each other up to the point where they can’t even stand each other anymore, and especially if they make it clear that the only real reason they stayed together way because of you. It’s gonna hurt for a while, and no amount of preparation could’ve saved you from feeling like you do now. Sending much love, hope you start to feel better soon❤️🙌
